AlternateTargets: come back to life after the end
Senses.Explanation: Literally, ‘after being completely cut off, revive again.’ The phrase occurs 222 times in 119 allowlisted texts. Its dominant fixed formula is ‘let go at the cliff and personally assent and undertake it; revive after being cut off, and you cannot deceive anyone’ (懸崖撒手，自肯承當；絕後再甦，欺君不得). Records also place it after ‘the life-root is severed’ (命根斷), beside ‘shed skin and exchange bones’ (去皮換骨), and compare it with a cold ember flaming and a withered tree flourishing again. One master explicitly departs from the inherited formula: ‘the former sages all wanted to revive after being cut off; I am not like that.’ The entry reports this recurrent sequence and its criticism without deciding what state the phrase denotes.
Senses.Note: Zen bends an ordinary death-and-revival image into a stock saying repeatedly quoted in teaching-seat discourse and biographies. It belongs with ‘let go at the cliff’ (懸崖撒手), ‘the life-root is severed’ (命根斷), and ‘gain life within death’ (死中得活), but remains one figurative referent rather than separate literal and technical objects.

Senses.Explanation: Appraisal-commentary on old cases or verses, including the activity, resulting text, and collections of that commentary. The term occurs 103 times in 28 allowlisted texts. Title constructions name Yuanwu appraising Xuedou's verses, Wansong appraising Tiantong's verses, and Linquan appraising verses associated with Touzi and Danxia. A preface gives the documentary sequence: “from recorded encounters, verses on old cases were made; from verses on old cases, appraisal-commentary collections were made” (由機緣而頌古作，由頌古而評唱集). A later poem heading speaks of “burning Wansong's appraisal-commentary on public cases” (焚萬松評唱公案), treating the text as a physical work. Chan makes appraisal-commentary a named layer of case literature beside verses on old cases and shorter attached comments. Commenting and the commentary produced are one commentarial event/product family, not different lexical referents.
Senses.Note: The former activity/product targets described the same appraisal-commentary and could not be distinguished as separate referents from the targets alone. Keep the genre distinct from an attached comment (著語), a substitute response (代語), laying down a response (下語), a verse on an old case (頌古), and picking up an old case (拈古).
